ev.q: the numbers of deaths reported this season cannot be compared directly with previous influenza seasons
Since October 2003, a total of 93 influenza-associated deaths among children aged <18 years have been reported to CDC.
Of the 55 children for whom the location of death was reported, 15 (27%) died at home
A total of 35 (38%) of the 93 children were reported to have had underlying chronic medical conditions
with 55 (59%) children aged <5 years and 24 (26%) aged 6--23 months
Since October 2003, a total of 93 influenza-associated deaths among children aged <18 years have been reported to CDC.
